caption:
Want Allah's mercy? Look at how you treat people

The Prophet ﷺ said that Allah will not be merciful to those who are not merciful to mankind. Think of one person you could be gentler with tomorrow.

Sahih al-Bukhari 7376 · Grade: Sahih

Name one person you will show more mercy to this week
